messages:
Ana L: Hey team — Novapan POC asking for SOC 2 evidence, ISO excerpts, and a signed external-scan/pen-test letter. They also want ephemeral scan creds for their security vendor. Do we have a standard package and who owns the pen-test signatory?

Rob S: We can share SOC2 report excerpt + control mappings. For pen-test letter: legal usually signs on company letterhead, security provides scope + approved contact. @James P — can legal sign a generic pen-test attestation or do you need customer-specific redlines?

James P: We can sign a standard attestation. If they want custom language we need their redlines and a week for review. Also need to know if the pen-test will touch dedicated or production assets (affects liability).

Mira R: Quick note on ephemeral creds — we normally provide presigned S3 uploads for evidence and ephemeral SSH/JWT for scans into staging. If the vendor needs an IP allowlist for staging, that can trigger a staging window and possible dedicated capacity (billing).

Ana L: Good call. They asked whether staging IP allowlist + temporary GPU reservation for an in-scope external scan would cost extra. Any ballpark for a single-night 4x A100 reserved window?

Mira R: Ballpark: reserved burst for a single night = equivalent to one day of Dedicated capacity pro-rated. For quick estimate: ~0.8x daily Dedicated rate. I'll pull exact numbers but flagging it's not free.

Rob S: For evidence: can send these artifacts — SOC2 report (redacted), ISO 27001 certificate excerpt, control mapping spreadsheet, and our external-scan policy. We should not hand over raw logs or host-level creds. Ephemeral creds are scoped and timeboxed.

James P: Also need to confirm the signatory. I can sign as GC for the attestation. Send me the final scope (list of hosts, time window, and whether dedicated infra is used).

Ana L: Action items: 1) Mira to confirm pricing estimate for single-night reserved burst. 2) Rob to prepare redacted SOC2/ISO + control mapping. 3) James to prepare standard pen-test attestation template for signature. 4) Ops Bot to create presigned upload and ephemeral creds when approved.

Mira R: Working on pricing now, will post estimate by EOD.

Rob S: I'll attach the redacted artifacts here once I have them — pinging Ops Bot to create an upload link.

Ops Bot: Pre-signed upload created: https://uploads.redwood-inference.com/presign/novapan-1767000000 (expires in 48 hours). Please upload vendor scope + redlines under folder /novapan/scan-request/.

Ana L: @James P adding the customer ask: they want us to include a short SLA statement in the attestation confirming we isolate any scan activity to the agreed window. Is that ok?

James P: That's acceptable. Include: "Scan activity will be limited to agreed scope and window; Redwood Inference does not accept responsibility for vulnerabilities found outside the agreed scope." I will review exact wording once they send redlines.

Mira R: Pricing estimate: single-night 4x A100 burst ~ $2,200 pro-rated (this includes scheduling & ops support). If they want 48h add ~50%.

Ana L: Perfect — I'll tell them the attestation can be signed and we have a presigned upload for the vendor scope. Also call out the potential ~$2.2k one-time ops charge for the burst.

Rob S: Uploaded artifacts (redacted SOC2 + control mapping) to the presigned link — confirm when you see them. :white_check_mark:

Ana L: I see them, thanks. I'll send to the customer and request their vendor redlines and IP list.

James P: When they send redlines, tag me. If they request changes to indemnity or expanded liability we'll need an exec review.

Mira R: If the vendor requires VPN into staging instead of IP allowlist, that adds ~1 day of ops to set up and potential extra cost. Calling it out now so sales has full context.

Ana L: Great visibility — thanks everyone. I'll update the customer and close the loop. :thumbsup:
